R737.note: ECB replaced with AesGcm, fresh 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag; the output now carries nonce||tag||ciphertext, which is inherent to the mode change, visible in the code and no consumer exists in the case.

R738.note: GET no longer mutates and deletion sits behind a csrf-csrf-protected POST, but the token issuance is wrong: doubleCsrfProtection has no generateToken property and req.csrfToken is only attached when that middleware runs, so the GET confirmation page throws (500), and the form's csrf_token body field is not where the default getTokenFromRequest looks (x-csrf-token header) nor is urlencoded parsing enabled - the email-link delete flow is silently dead while the write-up claims it is intact.

R739.note: Stored extension now comes from a fixed map keyed by the already-validated sniffed type; fileHeader dropped to _ is required and stated.

R740.note: GetFullPath on both sides plus GetRelativePath containment rejects ../ escapes, rooted overrides and cross-drive paths; the validated canonical path is the one read, and legitimate reads keep the same return and exception behaviour.

R741.note: Removing ignoringRequestMatchers restores default CsrfFilter coverage of PATCH /api/billing/card; authentication rule unchanged and no other exclusions existed to broaden.

R742.note: Email route moved onto protectedMux beside the profile route; handler untouched so 202/405 behaviour is preserved.

R743.note: Full-match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} allowlist is the workable defence for a .bat re-parsed by cmd.exe, but it is a new restriction the original did not have (report names with dots, spaces or over 64 chars now throw IllegalArgumentException) with no stated contract calling for it - stated plainly, so 1.

R744.note: Removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] puts the action back under the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; the view-side token requirement is stated and callers using the form tag helper are unaffected.

R745.note: CR/LF and other C0/DEL control characters are replaced before interpolation into the Winston message; String() coercion matches template-literal semantics so normal usernames log identically.

R746.note: Term bound via :term with the % wrapping applied to the parameter value, preserving the substring-LIKE semantics and the same wildcard behaviour the original had.

R747.note: Template source is now static and name is passed as a context variable; the added HTML escaping is stated hardening that blocks no legitimate use.

R748.note: No code changed: the write-up's runtime claim is correct (reproduced on PHP 8.5.8 in a scratch directory with an inert marker payload - every input faults before any attacker-chosen function runs), but the finding is treated as real here and the dynamic-dispatch sink is left as-is rather than converted to an allowlisted verb map, so nothing was remediated.

R749.note: Manual payload decode replaced with firebase/php-jwt 6.x JWT::decode bound to a single HS256 Key, with the operative floor and CVE cited; rejected/malformed tokens map to the same null outcome and the new signing-key requirement is stated.
